text: A prince who does not understand the art of war... cannot be respected by his soldiers, nor can he rely on them. He ought never, therefore, to have out of his thoughts this subject of war, and in peace he should addict himself more to its exercise than in war.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XIV, That which concerns a prince on the subject of war
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
